title: Block 2: Upgrade the Strategist phase logic to recursively decompose
description: Upgrade the Strategist phase logic to recursively decompose flat task lists into deeply nested `FractalNode` trees assigned to specialized roles like `TypographyExpert` or `LayoutArchitect`. [Acceptance Criteria: The Strategist generates a hierarchical, multi-level tree of tasks where each leaf node is assigned a distinct micro-agent role and strictly references only its parent node, proving no lateral communication.]
